title: Ask the Provisioner
description:
Ops will not hand-cut PVs for every lobby. Guestbook should **ask the provisioner**.

Use a StorageClass so a PVC provisions dynamically, then mount the volume into a pod. Binding a pre-made static PV to skip the class fails the spirit of the lab.

**Meant for:** StorageClass dynamic provisioning.

problemStatement.brief: Use a StorageClass so a PVC provisions dynamically and a pod mounts it — static PV cheating fails.
